info.title: InventraMed API
info.description: REST API for the InventraMed medicine inventory system.

servers.description: Default API prefix. Set by API_PREFIX.

post.description: Verifies the email and password and returns a signed access/refresh token pair.

400.description: Invalid request body, email or password

get.description: Returns one page of medicines, newest first. Deleted medicines are not listed. `name` and `barcode` match anywhere in the value, ignoring case; when both are given, both must match. `total` counts the medicines that match the filters, not the whole table.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only medicines whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: Only medicines whose barcode contains this text, ignoring case.

example.error: limit must be a whole number between 1 and 100

post.description: Registers a new medicine. Requires an access token in the Authorization header. The medicine is recorded as created by the token's user. A medicine is a duplicate when its name and batch number match an existing one (ignoring case), when its barcode is already used, even by a deleted medicine, or when another medicine that is not deleted is in the same location.

value.error: quantity must be zero or greater

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or non-access token

409.description: A medicine with the same name and batch number, the same barcode, or the same location already exists

value.error: medicine with this name and batch number already exists
medicine with this barcode already exists
another medicine is already in this location

get.description: Returns the medicine whose barcode matches exactly. A deleted medicine is not found. Public: no bearer token required, so the scanner page works without a logged-in session.

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: Barcode as read by the scanner. URL-encode reserved characters.

get.summary: Get the LED state of every placed medicine
get.description: Returns the expiration status of every active medicine placed in the tray, ordered by location, in one request with no pagination. Each item has the same fields as the scan messages relayed over the WebSocket server, with `type` set to `http` instead of `scan`, so the live view and the ESP32 light their LEDs on start with the same parsing. The status uses `warning_threshold_days` from the settings. The response is a bare array, not wrapped in `data`. Public: no bearer token required.

200.description: One item per placed medicine; an empty array when none is placed

put.description: Replaces the medicine's name, barcode, batch number, expiration date and location; an omitted batch number or location is cleared. The quantity cannot be changed here, and a `quantity` in the body is ignored. The medicine's own current values never count as duplicates. Otherwise a duplicate is another medicine with the same name and batch number (ignoring case), the same barcode, even a deleted one's, or the same location, unless that medicine is deleted.

400.description: Invalid medicine id, request body or field

invalidId.summary: The id is not a UUID

value.error: expiration_date must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format

409.description: Another medicine has the same name and batch number, the same barcode, or the same location

value.error: medicine with this name and batch number already exists
medicine with this barcode already exists
another medicine is already in this location

delete.description: Soft-deletes the medicine. It is refused while any purchase order that has not been deleted has an item for it, whatever the order's status. A deleted medicine keeps its barcode locked, so the barcode cannot be reused.

409.description: A purchase order uses the medicine

example.error: medicine is used in a purchase order and cannot be deleted

get.description: Returns the inventory settings. Public: no bearer token required, so the scanner page can compute a medicine's expiration status without a logged-in session.
Returns one page of inventory entries, newest first.

example.error: limit must be a whole number between 1 and 100

post.description: Creates a manual stock adjustment for a medicine. Entries are append-only: correcting a mistake means recording a new offsetting entry, not editing or deleting this one. The entry is recorded as counted by the token's user. `medicines.quantity` updates automatically from the entry via a database trigger. A `subtraction` that would take the medicine's quantity below zero is refused.

example.error: quantity must be greater than zero

404.description: medicine_id does not reference an active medicine

409.description: A subtraction would take the medicine's quantity below zero

404.description: No inventory entry with that id

get.description: Returns one page of suppliers, newest first. Deleted suppliers are not listed. `name` matches anywhere in the supplier's name, ignoring case. `total` counts the suppliers that match the filter, not the whole table. An offset past the end returns an empty page with the real total.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only suppliers whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

example.error: limit must be a whole number between 1 and 100

post.description: Registers a new supplier. Requires an access token in the Authorization header. The name must be unique among suppliers that have not been deleted, ignoring case; email and phone are not checked, so two suppliers may share them. Optional fields that are empty are stored as no value.

example.error: email must be a valid email address

put.description: Replaces the supplier's name, contact name, email, phone and address; an omitted or empty optional field is cleared. The supplier's own current name never counts as a duplicate. Otherwise a duplicate is another supplier that has not been deleted with the same name, ignoring case.

400.description: Invalid supplier id, request body or field

invalidId.summary: The id is not a UUID

delete.description: Soft-deletes the supplier. It is refused while any purchase order that has not been deleted references it, whatever the order's status.

409.description: A purchase order uses the supplier

example.error: supplier is used in a purchase order and cannot be deleted

get.description: Returns one page of purchase orders, newest first. Deleted purchase orders are not listed. Each entry is the order's header only; get an order by id for its items and receipts. `total` counts every active purchase order, not just the page. An offset past the end returns an empty page with the real total.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of purchase orders to skip.

example.error: limit must be a whole number between 1 and 100

post.description: Creates a purchase order for a supplier with its items, in the `draft` status. Requires an access token in the Authorization header. The order is recorded as created by the token's user. The supplier and every medicine must exist and not be deleted. A medicine may appear only once in `items`. Order and item creation are recorded in the audit log. There is no way to change or delete a purchase order yet.

201.description: The newly created purchase order, with its items

400.description: Invalid request body or field. Item errors name the item by its zero-based position.

value.error: expected_date must not be before order_date
items[1].quantity_ordered must be greater than zero

404.description: The supplier or a medicine does not exist or was deleted

get.description: Returns the purchase order with its items and its receipts, each receipt with what was received per item.

post.description: Receives every item of the purchase order in full: records one receipt with a receipt item per order item (received equals ordered, nothing damaged or returned), adds each received quantity to its medicine's stock, and sets the order's status to `received`, all in one transaction. Only a `draft` or `ordered` purchase order can be received. The receiver is the token's user. The request body is optional.

201.description: The new receipt, with its items

400.description: Invalid purchase order id, request body or field

invalidId.summary: The id is not a UUID

409.description: The purchase order's status is not `draft` or `ordered`, for example because it was already received

example.error: purchase order cannot be received in its current status

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, expired or non-access token

MedicineNotFound.description: No medicine with that id or barcode, or it was deleted

SupplierNotFound.description: No supplier with that id, or it was deleted

SupplierNameExists.description: Another supplier that has not been deleted already has this name, ignoring case

example.error: supplier with this name already exists

PurchaseOrderNotFound.description: No purchase order with that id, or it was deleted

bearerAuth.description: Access token from POST /login, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Refresh tokens are rejected.

barcode.description: Read by the scanner. Must be unique across all medicines, including deleted ones.

batch_number.description: Optional. An empty value is stored as no batch number.

location.description: Optional tray compartment (1–12, row-major from the back-left pocket as seen from the front). Omit or send null when the medicine is not placed in the tray. Must not be used by another active medicine.
Tray compartment (1–12, row-major from the back-left pocket as seen from the front). null when the medicine is not placed in the tray.

barcode.description: Must be unique across all medicines, including deleted ones.

batch_number.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value clears the batch number.

location.description: Optional. An omitted or null value clears the location. Tray compartment (1–12, row-major from the back-left pocket as seen from the front). Must not be used by another active medicine.

total.description: Number of medicines matching the filters, across all pages.

type.description: Message type, always `http`, which tells these items apart from the `scan` messages relayed over the WebSocket server.

location.description: Tray compartment (1–12, row-major from the back-left pocket as seen from the front).

status.description: Which LED to light: `good` (green) far from expiration, `near` (yellow) within `warning_threshold_days` of the expiration date, `expire` (red) past the expiration date. Computed from calendar days in UTC.

warning_threshold_days.description: How many days before its expiration date a medicine counts as nearing expiration.

quantity.description: The amount being added or subtracted.

reason.description: Free text, e.g. count_adjustment, returned, damaged, lost, expired_removal.

notes.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no notes.

InventoryEntryCountedBy.description: The user who counted the entry, joined in by ID.

total.description: Number of inventory entries, across all pages.

CreateSupplierRequest.description: All string fields are trimmed before they are validated.

name.description: Must be unique among suppliers that have not been deleted, ignoring case.

contact_name.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no value.

email.description: Optional. Must be a valid email address when given.

phone.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no value.

address.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no value.

UpdateSupplierRequest.description: Same shape as the create request. An update replaces every field, so an omitted optional field is cleared.

name.description: Must be unique among suppliers that have not been deleted, ignoring case.

contact_name.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no value.

email.description: Optional. Must be a valid email address when given. An empty or omitted value clears it.

phone.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no value.

address.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no value.

total.description: Number of suppliers matching the filter, across all pages.

CreatePurchaseOrderRequest.description: All string fields are trimmed before they are validated. The creator is always the token's user; a `created_by` or `status` in the body is ignored.

expected_date.description: Optional. Must not be before `order_date`. An empty or omitted value is stored as no date.

notes.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no notes.

items.description: A medicine may appear only once.

ReceivePurchaseOrderRequest.description: The whole body is optional; an empty body is the same as `{}`. The receiver is always the token's user; a `received_by` in the body is ignored.

notes.description: Optional. An empty or omitted value is stored as no notes.

PurchaseOrder.description: A purchase order's header, without its items or receipts.

status.description: New orders are `draft`; receiving sets `received`. The other statuses are not reachable through the API yet.

quantity_damaged.description: Always 0 for now: only full receiving is implemented.

quantity_returned.description: Always 0 for now: only full receiving is implemented.

PurchaseOrderDetail.description: A purchase order with its items and its receipts.

receipts.description: Empty until the order is received.

total.description: Number of purchase orders, across all pages.
